card.name: Linking words in preparation and monitoring instructions
card.fires_on: Small connecting words or punctuation inside set label phrases, such as 'not more than', 'has been demonstrated', 'reassessed to determine', and 'prior to administration,'. They appear in instructions for preparing, storing and monitoring drug products.

modes.label: Reconstitution and stability phrasing
modes.description: Words like 'more' or 'been' inside dilution and in-use stability sentences.
modes.example: first prepare solution by adding not<< more>> than 2 mL of Bacteri

modes.label: Monitoring and inspection phrasing
modes.description: A linking word or comma in stock phrases about reassessing patients or inspecting parenteral products.
modes.example: Patients should be periodically reassessed<< to>> determine the need for maintenance treatment.

card.plain: It fires on small linking words in stock instruction sentences about mixing, storing, inspecting and reassessing.
